title: Delivered the first release of the AI traceability platform
summary: I led delivery of the traceability platform's first capability, which went live on release-document data from three business teams.
what_would_have_happened: Traceability would stay manual, spread across documents and tools, and slow to audit.
the_call: Model the trace as a knowledge graph on top of existing tools, with people approving every link.
what_i_did: Led delivery of the first use case, wrote the release notes for business stakeholders and set out the path to the internal developer portal.
what_changed: Release data from three business teams was traceable end to end in one place, and the milestone review confirmed the project was on track.
